Here's what I do in the first hour at any big conference, and Las Vegas is the biggest of all. First, I don't go straight to the floor. I sit down with a coffee and the floor plan for ten minutes, and I choose three booths. Only three. Then I walk in and scan the room near the entrance. I look for small groups of two, not big groups of six. Two people are easy to join. Six people are a meeting. My opening line is always a question about the event, never about me. Something like, which session has been the best so far? People love to answer that. And the last thing: I try to lock in one real meeting before lunch. Just one. If I do that, the trip is already worth it.

Good morning, and welcome to day one. A few quick things before you hit the ground running. The convention center has three halls, and the floor plan is in the conference app, so please download it now. The flagship booths are in Hall A, next to the main stage. The demo stations are all in Hall C, and the first live demos start at ten. Today's sponsored sessions are on the second floor, and they are open to every badge. If you need a private room for a meeting, please book it at the help desk before noon. And finally, tonight's afterparty starts at eight, by the pool. Your badge is your ticket, so please don't lose it. Enjoy the day.
